issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED may not exist in 0.0.99 SDK, causing AttributeError on import
issues.detail: _enable_vad now checks `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED` but the diff never confirms this enum value exists in speechmatics 0.0.99. If only the new TurnDetectionMode adds FIXED while EndOfUtteranceMode does not, instantiation will raise AttributeError at startup. Verify the underlying SDK exposes this member or add a getattr guard.

issues.description: Default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent breaking change for existing users
issues.detail: Existing callers relying on default `turn_detection_mode=EXTERNAL` will silently switch to FIXED on upgrade, altering endpointing behavior and frame emission semantics (VAD frames suppressed). This is a behavioral regression masked as a bugfix; either keep EXTERNAL as default or call it out as a breaking change in a major/minor bump.

issues.description: Finalization handler only triggers on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, breaking non-VAD pipelines
issues.detail: process_frame switched from `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame` to `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame`. Pipelines using FIXED/EXTERNAL turn detection without VAD (e.g., push-to-talk, manual turn control) emit only UserStoppedSpeakingFrame and will no longer trigger `_client.finalize()`, leaving transcripts unfinalized.

issues.description: speech_segment_config is unconditionally overwritten, ignoring any prior config state
issues.detail: `config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=...)` overwrites whatever was set by the dynamic loop above or any future fields on SpeechSegmentConfig. If users supply other segment-related params through kwargs, they will be silently dropped. Merge into existing config instead of replacing.

issues.description: split_sentences declared as Optional[bool] but coerced via `or False`, hiding misuse
issues.detail: Declaring `split_sentences: bool | None = None` then writing `params.split_sentences or False` makes `False` and `None` indistinguishable and prevents detecting unset vs explicitly-false intent. Either make it `bool = False` directly, or preserve None to defer to SDK default.

issues.description: Changelog entries inconsistent: added.md mentions split_sentences, fixed.md does not list it
issues.detail: The split_sentences addition is documented only in 3328.added.md while 3328.fixed.md enumerates the other changes. Consider cross-referencing or grouping so users reading either file get a complete picture of the 0.0.99 upgrade impact, including the default mode change which is arguably a breaking change worth its own callout.

review.summary: The PR changes default turn-detection behavior and rewires finalization to VAD-specific frames, both of which carry real regression risk for existing integrations. The biggest concerns are (1) a possibly nonexistent `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED` enum member that could fail at import/instantiation, (2) a silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED, and (3) finalization no longer firing for non-VAD pipelines that emit only `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame`. Minor issues around config overwriting and an Optional[bool] coerced with `or False` should be cleaned up. Changelog coverage of the breaking default change is thin.
